title.narrative: CnC MASPD Jiva Farmer Financing Pilot

description.narrative: The International Finance Corporation (IFC), a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), is partnering with Jiva Ag Pte Ltd (Jiva), through a Co-Development Agreement. Jiva operates a digital platform in Indonesia that provides local smallholder farmers with access to an ecosystem of agricultural input purchasing, cashless financing facilities, market linkages, and AI-powered agronomic advice. The Project will support Jiva in further developing, strengthening, and expanding its business model, including enhancing its environmental & social (E&S) approach and supporting the structuring of farmer and micro-collector financing operations (the Project).

name.narrative: Indonesia. Jiva started its operations in Indonesia in early 2021 focusing only on corn-producing areas and farmers in South Sulawesi before entering East Java Province in late 2021. Jiva is working on expanding its operations to additional corn-producing provinces in Indonesia and across other crops.
